title: Assembly and Annotation of the Scapharca Broughtonii Genome
author: Chang-Ming CM Bai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z7zf9p6
materials: in previous study, and reassembled by Hisat (v2.0.

steps.title: Prepare Raw Sequencing Data
steps.instruction: Process raw data from PacBio and Nanopore platforms.

substeps.instruction: Base-call the data
Perform quality control
Combine the datasets
Transfer data to FASTA format for assembly

steps.title: Perform Initial Long Read Assembly
steps.instruction: Run Canu (v1.5) for long reads correction, trimming, and assembly using correctedErrorRate=0.045 and corOutCoverage=6.

steps.title: Perform Secondary Assembly
steps.instruction: Run Wtdbg (v1.1) on the data obtained from the Canu assembly using -k 21 (Kmer size: 21) and -e 3 (Min cov of edges=3), with all other parameters set to default.

steps.title: Merge and Polish Assembly
steps.instruction: Combine and refine the assembled results from the previous steps.

substeps.instruction: Run Quickmerge (v0.2.2) with parameters: -hco 5.0 (overlap cutoff for anchor contigs), -c 1.5 (overlap cutoff for extension of anchor contig), -l 400000 (length cutoff for anchor contigs), and -ml 5000 (minimum alignment length for merging).
Run Numer (v4.0.0) using default parameters to remove redundancy.
Run Pilon (v1.22) using Illumina reads to correct sequencing errors with -mindepth 10 and other parameters set to default.

steps.title: Evaluate Assembly Quality
steps.instruction: Assess the quality of the assembly using mapping and conserved gene searches.

substeps.instruction: Run SAMTools (v0.1.18) to map 360,937,442 Illumina reads for genome survey to the assembly (no specific parameters).
Run BUSCO (v2.0) using default parameters to search for 303 eukaryotic and 978 metazoan conserved genes.

steps.title: Build De Novo Repeat Library
steps.instruction: Construct a repeat library using LTR FINDER (v1.05), RepeatScout (v1.0.5), and PILER-DF (v2.4) with default parameters.

steps.title: Classify and Finalize Repeat Library
steps.instruction: Classify repetitive sequences using PASTEClassifier (V1.0) with default parameters and combine with the Repbase database to create the final library.

steps.title: Identify and Mask Repeats
steps.instruction: Identify and mask repetitive regions in the genome to prepare for gene prediction.

substeps.instruction: Run RepeatMasker (v4.0.6) using the library from the previous step as a database with parameters: -nolow -no_is -norna -engine wublast -qq -frag 20000.
Mask the identified repetitive regions with 'N's.

steps.title: Predict Genes via Transcriptome Data
steps.instruction: Predict gene functions using transcriptome data.

substeps.instruction: Download S. broughtonii transcriptome data from NCBI.
Assemble Illumina data using Trinity (v.r20140413p1) with min_kmer_cov:2 and default parameters; reassemble using Hisat (v2.0.4) and Stringtie (v1.2.3) with default parameters.
Process PacBio data as full-length transcripts after quality control.
Run TransDecoder v2.0 and GeneMark (v5.1) with default parameters to predict gene functions.

steps.title: Perform Homology-Based Gene Prediction
steps.instruction: Run GeMoMa (v1.3.1) with default parameters for homology-based prediction by aligning the assembled genome against four closely related species (Danio rerio, Crassostrea gigas, Mizuhopecten yessoensis, and Mytilus galloprovincialis) downloaded from NCBI.

steps.title: Perform De Novo Gene Prediction
steps.instruction: Run the following tools with default parameters to predict genes in the repeat-masked genome sequence: Augustus (v. 2.4), Genscan (v. 3.1), GlimmerHMM (v3.0.4), GeneID (v1.4), and SNAP (version 2006-07-28).

steps.title: Integrate Gene Predictions
steps.instruction: Run EVM (v1.1.1) to obtain a consensus gene set by integrating predictions from previous steps using a STANDARD S-ratio of 1.13 and score > 1000.

substeps.instruction: Apply the following weights: PROTEIN OTHER (50), PROTEIN GeMoMa (50), TRANSCRIPT assembler-PASA (50), TRANSCRIPT Stringtie (20), ABINITIO_PREDICTION genscan (0.3), ABINITIO_PREDICTION AUGUSTUS (0.3), ABINITIO_PREDICTION GlimmerHMM (0.3), ABINITIO_PREDICTION SNAP (0.3), ABINITIO_PREDICTION geneID (0.3), ABINITIO_PREDICTION GeMoMa (0.3), and OTHER_PREDICTION OTHER (100).

steps.title: Refine Predicted Genes
steps.instruction: Run PASA v2.0.2 with default parameters to modify the genes predicted in the consensus set.

steps.title: Annotate Gene Functions and Motifs
steps.instruction: Map the final gene set protein sequences to databases to identify functions or motifs.

substeps.instruction: Use BLAST (v2.2.31) with -max_target_seqs 100 for Nr (downloaded 2017.04.05), Nt (downloaded 2017.04.05), SwissProt, TrEMBL, KOG, and KEGG (others downloaded 2017.02.13).
Use HMMer (v3.0) for Pfam with -E 0.00001 and --domE 0.00001, and other default parameters.
Use BLAST2GO (v2.5) with default parameters for GO.
Run genBlastA (v1.0.4) based on homology using -e 1e-5.
Run GeneWise (v2.4.1) based on mutations using -both -pseudo.

steps.title: Predict tRNA
steps.instruction: Run tRNAscan-SE (v1.3.1) with default parameters to predict tRNA.

steps.title: Predict miRNA and rRNA
steps.instruction: Run Infernal (v1.1) with default parameters to predict miRNA and rRNA based on Rfam v12.1 and miRBase v21.0 databases.
